description: This file implements WebSocket handling for Mattermost integration, including event parsing, WebSocket connection management, health checks, and error handling.

classes.name: WebSocketClosedBeforeOpenError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating WebSocket closed before it was opened.

methods.name: parseMattermostEventPayload

methods.name: parseMattermostPost

methods.name: parsePostedPayload
